titleEn: Bathroom Renovation Cost in Vancouver in 2026: What to Expect
titleZh: 温哥华浴室翻新费用2026：您需要了解什么
contentEn:
A bathroom renovation in Vancouver costs between $12,000 and $45,000 in 2026, depending on the scope of work, materials selected, and the contractor you hire. A basic refresh — new flooring, vanity, toilet, and paint — typically starts around $12,000 to $18,000. A full gut renovation with custom cabinetry, heated floors, and premium tile can exceed $40,000. Reno Stars has completed bathroom renovation projects across Vancouver, Burnaby, and Richmond, with pricing that reflects real local labour and material costs.

Planning a bathroom renovation in Vancouver and want to understand what drives the cost? This guide walks through every line item so you can budget accurately before signing a contract.

What Drives Your Bathroom Renovation Cost in Vancouver

Three factors determine whether you pay $12,000 or $45,000:

  • Scope of work: A cosmetic refresh is dramatically cheaper than moving plumbing fixtures. Moving a toilet or shower drain requires a plumbing permit and can add $3,000–$8,000 to your project.
  • Materials: Ceramic tile runs $3–$12 per square foot installed. Porcelain and natural stone are $8–$25 per square foot. A custom glass shower enclosure alone can cost $2,000–$6,000.
  • Labour in Metro Vancouver: Skilled tradespeople in the Vancouver area charge $75–$130 per hour. A complete bathroom renovation typically requires a plumber, electrician, and general contractor working together for 3–6 weeks.

Vancouver Bathroom Renovation Cost by Scope

Use the table below to estimate based on your project size. These are ranges for a standard 40–60 square foot bathroom in the Vancouver area.

How to Save on Your Vancouver Bathroom Renovation

Even in a high-cost market like Vancouver, smart choices reduce the final invoice:

  • Keep plumbing locations fixed: Moving pipes is one of the most expensive line items. Keep your toilet, sink, and shower in their existing locations to save $3,000–$8,000.
  • Choose porcelain tile over natural stone: Porcelain costs less to install and requires less maintenance than marble or granite.
  • Refinish instead of replacing: If your bathtub is structurally sound, refinishing costs $400–$800 versus $2,500–$5,000 for a new install.
  • Phase the project: Complete the demolition and waterproofing in one phase, then add finishing touches in a second phase to spread costs over time.

Do You Need a Permit for a Bathroom Renovation in Vancouver?

Vancouver and most Metro Vancouver municipalities require a building permit for bathroom renovations that involve:

  • Moving or adding plumbing fixtures (adding or relocating a toilet, shower, or sink)
  • Electrical work beyond simple fixture replacement
  • Structural changes including removing walls or altering partitions

A plumbing permit in Vancouver typically costs $150–$500 depending on the scope. Electrical permits add another $100–$300. Your contractor should include permit costs in their quote — ask to see them line by line before signing.

Frequently Asked Questions About Bathroom Renovation Costs in Vancouver

How much does a small bathroom renovation cost in Vancouver?

A small bathroom (under 35 square feet) in Vancouver costs $8,000 to $15,000 for a basic refresh and $15,000 to $25,000 for a mid-range renovation. The lower cost reflects reduced material quantities and a shorter labour timeline.

What is the most expensive part of a bathroom renovation?

Plumbing and electrical work are the most expensive components, often representing 30–40% of the total budget. Custom glass enclosures, premium tile, and cabinetry are the next largest line items.

How long does a bathroom renovation take in Vancouver?

A basic bathroom refresh takes 2–3 weeks. A mid-range renovation takes 3–5 weeks. A full gut renovation with custom finishes takes 5–8 weeks. Permit processing in Vancouver typically adds 1–3 weeks to the timeline before work begins.

Does homeowners insurance cover bathroom renovations?

Standard homeowners insurance covers damage from sudden events (a pipe burst, fire, or flood) but does not cover gradual wear or age-related deterioration. If your bathroom was damaged by a covered peril, document everything and contact your insurer before beginning repairs.

温哥华的浴室翻新费用在2026年介于$12,000至$45,000加元之间，具体取决于工程范围、材料选择及所聘用的承包商。基础翻新（地板、洗手台、马桶和油漆）通常在$12,000至$18,000之间。全面拆除重建配合定制橱柜、地暖地板和高级瓷砖可能超过$40,000。Reno Stars已在温哥华、本拿比和列治文完成多个浴室翻新项目，价格反映真实本地人工和材料成本。

影响温哥华浴室翻新费用的因素

三大因素决定费用是$12,000还是$45,000：

  • 工程范围：表面翻新比移动管道便宜得多。移动马桶或淋浴排水管需要管道许可，并可能额外花费$3,000至$8,000。
  • 材料：陶瓷瓷砖每平方英尺安装费用$3至$12。瓷器和天然石材为$8至$25。定制玻璃淋浴间仅一项就可能花费$2,000至$6,000。
  • 大温地区人工：温哥华地区的熟练技工收费$75至$130/小时。完整的浴室翻新通常需要水管工、电工和总承包商协同工作3至6周。

按工程范围的温哥华浴室翻新费用

翻新类型预估费用（加元）工期
基础翻新（油漆、洗手台、马桶、地板）$12,000 – $18,0002–3周
中档翻新（新瓷砖、独立淋浴间、更新管道）$18,000 – $30,0003–5周
豪华全面翻新（定制橱柜、地暖、高级石材）$30,000 – $45,000+5–8周

如何节省温哥华浴室翻新费用

  • 保持管道位置固定：移动管道是最昂贵的项目之一。保持马桶、洗脸盆和淋浴在现有位置可节省$3,000至$8,000。
  • 选择瓷质瓷砖而非天然石材：瓷器成本更低，安装和维护要求也比大理石或花岗岩低。
  • 翻新而非更换：如果浴缸结构完好，翻新费用$400至$800，而更换新安装费用为$2,500至$5,000。

温哥华浴室翻新需要许可证吗？

温哥华及大温大多数市政当局对涉及以下情况的浴室翻新要求建筑许可证：移动或新增管道装置、简单灯具更换以外的电气工程，以及拆除墙壁或更改隔断等结构变更。温哥华的管道许可证通常费用为$150至$500，电气许可证另加$100至$300。

关于温哥华浴室翻新费用的常见问题

温哥华小浴室翻新费用是多少？

温哥华小于35平方英尺的小浴室，基础翻新费用为$8,000至$15,000，中档翻新为$15,000至$25,000。成本较低反映了材料用量减少和工期缩短。

浴室翻新中最昂贵的部分是什么？

管道和电气工程是最昂贵的部分，通常占总预算的30至40%。定制玻璃隔断、优质瓷砖和橱柜是接下来最大的支出项目。

温哥华的浴室翻新需要多长时间？

基础浴室翻新需2至3周。中档翻新需3至5周。全面翻新需5至8周。温哥华的许可证处理通常在工作开始前额外增加1至3周。
